row.notes: Builds the 5-bit LED mask of one rev-light group: param_1 = lit count in this group, param_2 = LED config flags (bit1/bit2 modes, bits 10-14 force single LEDs), param_3/param_4 = blink/limiter modes. Car_SteeringWheelLeds_Update calls it 3x (counts n, n-5, n-10) and packs g3<<10 | g2<<5 | g1. Callers: Car_SteeringWheelLeds_Update.

verify.notes: V3728 5-bit LED group mask from lit count, flag bits 1/2, bits 10-14 (param_4 mode) force single LEDs; Update (0x142f3fc20) calls it with n, n-5, n-10 (decomp lines 365/370/374).
